# membership degree index

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:membershipDegreeIndex`](gmeow-membershipDegreeIndex.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/membershipDegreeIndex>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)

The zero-based degree index of the member pitch within the collection, when the collection has a conventional ordering (e.g. scale degree 0 = tonic/finalis). Optional.

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:PitchCollectionMembership`](../classes/gmeow-PitchCollectionMembership.md) -> [`xsd:integer`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#integer); functional

Use [`gmeow:membershipDegreeIndex`](gmeow-membershipDegreeIndex.md) from [`gmeow:PitchCollectionMembership`](../classes/gmeow-PitchCollectionMembership.md) to [`xsd:integer`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#integer) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
